brief: id: "cinder-flats". name: "Cinder Flats". Theme: a black volcanic plain under low cloud, ash drifts across the road. Length about 1450 m. Character: fast and flowing, the kind of track where a good line matters more than braking. Four long sweepers and one late-apex right that punishes early throttle. Width 19-23 m. Mostly tarmac with one contiguous dirt run through an ash drift. Elevation within 8 m. Two ramps, launches 6 and 8. Boost pads on sweeper exits. MINIMUM CORNER RADIUS 40 m, no hairpins - AI racers must complete laps without spinning off.

id: "tidewater". name: "Tidewater". Theme: a causeway between salt flats, water either side, low sun. Length about 1350 m. Character: the second-easiest track. Wide, open, forgiving; a good place to learn to drift. Width 21-25 m. Three big radius corners and a long back straight. All tarmac. Almost flat, within 5 m. One ramp over a sluice gate, launch 5. Three boost pads. Item boxes in wide rows of 5. MINIMUM CORNER RADIUS 45 m, no hairpins.

id: "quarry-run". name: "Quarry Run". Theme: a working stone quarry, terraced walls, gravel spill. Length about 1600 m. Character: medium-hard, defined by a long descent and a tight-ish climb back out. Elevation drops 18 m then climbs back. Width 17-21 m. A third of the lap is dirt through the gravel spill. Two ramps on the descent, launches 7 and 10. MINIMUM CORNER RADIUS 40 m, no hairpins, turns spread over 4+ control points.

id: "arcadia-mall". name: "Arcadia Mall". Theme: a shuttered shopping arcade at night, polished floors, neon signage. Length about 1300 m. Character: technical but drivable - rhythm and corner-exit speed, not tightness. Six corners of 60-90 degrees, each spread across at least 4 control points, separated by straights of 80 m or more. Width 18-22 m. All tarmac, flat within 4 m. No ramps. Four boost pads on corner exits. 14-16 checkpoints. MINIMUM CORNER RADIUS 40 m, absolutely no hairpins.

id: "pinewood-loop". name: "Pinewood Loop". Theme: a forestry road looping through pine plantation, long shadows. Length about 1700 m. Character: medium, rhythmic, lots of gentle direction changes. Width 18-22 m. Rolling elevation within 14 m, changing gradually. Mostly tarmac with a short dirt logging spur. One ramp, launch 8. Item boxes spread evenly. MINIMUM CORNER RADIUS 42 m, no hairpins.

id: "saltworks". name: "Saltworks". Theme: evaporation pans and crusted white terraces, blinding light. Length about 1500 m. Character: fast, wide, deceptively easy to overcook. Width 22-26 m, genuinely varying across that range. Three enormous sweepers and one slower complex. All tarmac. Elevation within 6 m. Two ramps, launches 6 and 9. MINIMUM CORNER RADIUS 45 m, no hairpins.

id: "ironworks". name: "Ironworks". Theme: a derelict steel mill, gantries overhead, rust and sodium light. Length about 1400 m. Character: medium-hard, industrial, a couple of blind crests. Width 18-21 m. Elevation within 12 m with two crests that unsettle the kart. All tarmac. Three ramps, launches 6, 8 and 11. Two boost pads only. MINIMUM CORNER RADIUS 40 m, no hairpins.

id: "monsoon-dock". name: "Monsoon Dock". Theme: a container port in heavy rain, standing water, stacked containers. Length about 1450 m. Character: medium, boxy, corridor-like but never tight. Width 19-22 m. Six corners of 60-90 degrees spread over 4+ control points each. All tarmac, flat within 5 m. No ramps. Four boost pads. MINIMUM CORNER RADIUS 40 m, no hairpins, no chicanes.

id: "highland-pass". name: "Highland Pass". Theme: a moorland road over a saddle, heather and stone walls. Length about 1750 m. Character: the longest and most scenic, defined by one big climb and descent. Elevation rises 20 m then falls, gradually, never more than 3 m between consecutive points. Width 18-22 m. Mostly tarmac, short dirt section at the summit. One ramp at the bottom of the descent, launch 10. MINIMUM CORNER RADIUS 42 m, no hairpins.

id: "neon-harbour". name: "Neon Harbour". Theme: a waterfront strip at night, reflections on wet asphalt, palms. Length about 1400 m. Character: fast and showy, a signature track. Width 20-24 m. Four flowing corners and one long curving straight along the water. All tarmac, flat within 6 m. Two ramps over slipways, launches 6 and 8. Four boost pads. MINIMUM CORNER RADIUS 42 m, no hairpins.

id: "dustbowl". name: "Dustbowl". Theme: an abandoned farmstead circuit, dry earth, broken fencing. Length about 1550 m. Character: the dirt track - roughly half the lap is dirt, which should feel loose but still be drivable. Width 18-22 m, widening to 22 m through the dirt so there is room to slide. Elevation within 10 m. Two ramps, launches 7 and 9. MINIMUM CORNER RADIUS 42 m, no hairpins.

id: "observatory". name: "Observatory". Theme: a mountaintop road spiralling around a domed observatory, stars overhead. Length about 1500 m. Character: hard but fair - heavy banking and commitment, no tight corners. Width 17-21 m. Banking up to the 0.35 limit on the two fastest corners. Elevation rises and falls about 16 m. All tarmac. Two ramps, launches 8 and 11. Only two boost pads. MINIMUM CORNER RADIUS 40 m, no hairpins.
